authority: National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC) & ICMR Guidelines

chemicals_and_dosages.name: Temephos 50% EC (Abate)
chemicals_and_dosages.target: Aedes aegypti, Anopheles, and Culex mosquito larvae
chemicals_and_dosages.dosage: 1 ppm (1 ml per 1,000 Litres of potable or clean stored water)
chemicals_and_dosages.application_sites: Domestic water storage containers, overhead tanks, masonry tanks, cement cisterns, desert coolers
chemicals_and_dosages.safety_instructions: Safe for drinking water at 1 ppm statutory concentration. Do not overdose. Repeat every 10 to 14 days.

chemicals_and_dosages.name: Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis (Bti) WP / AS
chemicals_and_dosages.target: Biological larvicide for mosquito larvae (dipteran specific)
chemicals_and_dosages.dosage: 0.5 g to 1.0 g per square meter of water surface area (wettable powder) or 1–2 ml/sq.m (aqueous suspension)
chemicals_and_dosages.application_sites: Desert coolers, ornamental ponds, domestic water containers, fountains, slow drains
chemicals_and_dosages.safety_instructions: Completely non-toxic to human beings, fish, mammals, and birds. Endotoxin crystallizes in alkaline larval gut.

chemicals_and_dosages.name: Diflubenzuron 25% WP (Insect Growth Regulator)
chemicals_and_dosages.target: Chitin synthesis inhibitor preventing larval pupation to adult stage
chemicals_and_dosages.dosage: 1.0 g per 1,000 Litres of water (0.25 to 1.0 ppm a.i.)
chemicals_and_dosages.application_sites: Large storage tanks, construction sumps, stagnant ground pools, abandoned swimming pools
chemicals_and_dosages.safety_instructions: Prevents mosquito emergence by inhibiting cuticle formation. Does not kill fourth instar or pupae immediately.

chemicals_and_dosages.name: Pyrosene Oil / MLO (Mosquito Larvicidal Oil)
chemicals_and_dosages.target: Physical suffocant forming thin monomolecular film over water
chemicals_and_dosages.dosage: 15 to 20 ml per square meter of water surface area
chemicals_and_dosages.application_sites: Drainage channels, polluted cesspools, septic tanks, sewage overflows (NON-POTABLE ONLY)
chemicals_and_dosages.safety_instructions: Strictly FORBIDDEN for drinking water containers. Use exclusively on highly polluted or organically rich stagnant drains.

chemicals_and_dosages.name: Malathion (5% Technical in Diesel) for Thermal Fogging
chemicals_and_dosages.target: Adult biting mosquitoes during acute outbreak clusters
chemicals_and_dosages.dosage: 50 ml of technical grade Malathion per Litre of diesel oil, discharged at 10–20 Litres/hectare
chemicals_and_dosages.application_sites: Outdoor thermal fogging during dawn (06:00–08:00) or dusk (17:30–19:30) when vector flight is peak
chemicals_and_dosages.safety_instructions: Evacuate children and elders from immediate path. Direct fog into dense vegetation, building perimeter, and dark crevices.

biological_control.stocking_rate: 5 to 10 fish per square meter of water surface area (for small ponds/cisterns: 20–30 fish per 1,000 L)
biological_control.efficiency: Single fish consumes 100 to 300 larvae within 24 hours. Thrives in shallow, clear, or moderately turbid water.
biological_control.notes: Best suited for unchlorinated cement storage tanks, rural open wells, garden ponds, construction sumps.

biological_control.stocking_rate: 10 to 15 fish per square meter of water surface area
biological_control.efficiency: Highly tolerant of moderate organic pollution and wastewater drains compared to Gambusia.
biological_control.notes: Ideal for unlined drains, sullage pools, and semi-polluted urban water bodies.

entomological_indices.formula: BI = (Number of positive containers / Total number of houses inspected) * 100

severity_thresholds.critical: > 20.0 (High epidemic transmission potential - statutory emergency action)

entomological_indices.significance: Most reliable indicator of vector density and community outbreak vulnerability.

entomological_indices.formula: HI = (Number of positive houses / Total number of houses inspected) * 100
entomological_indices.significance: Percentage of premises harboring active mosquito breeding.

entomological_indices.formula: CI = (Number of positive water containers / Total water containers inspected) * 100
entomological_indices.significance: Proportion of water-holding receptacles positive for immature vector stages.

vector_identification.vector: Aedes aegypti (Yellow Fever / Dengue / Chikungunya Mosquito)
vector_identification.visual_markers: Pitch black body with brilliant silvery-white lyre-shaped markings on thorax dorsal surface; banded legs.
vector_identification.biting_habit: Exclusively diurnal (daytime biter), peak activity 2 hours after sunrise and 2 hours before dusk.
vector_identification.breeding_preference: Artificial, clean stagnant domestic water receptacles (coolers, flower pots, discarded tyres, overhead tanks, unsealed plastic drums).

vector_identification.visual_markers: Wings spotted with dark and pale scales; rests at 45-degree angle to the surface; proboscis and body in straight line.
vector_identification.biting_habit: Nocturnal (bites from dusk till dawn, 21:00 to 04:00 peak).
vector_identification.breeding_preference: Overhead masonry tanks, roof water collections, domestic storage pots, curing tanks at construction sites.

vector_identification.visual_markers: Brownish mosquito, blunt abdomen, rests parallel to the surface.
vector_identification.biting_habit: Nocturnal biter in indoor living quarters.
vector_identification.breeding_preference: Heavily polluted, foul-smelling stagnant drains, cesspools, septic tanks.

standard_operating_procedures.title: Dry Day SOP for Desert Coolers
steps: Empty water completely at least once every 7 days ('Dry Day' protocol).
Scrub cooler sides and bottom with brush to dislodge attached Aedes eggs which survive desiccation up to 6 months.
Allow to dry under sun for minimum 2 hours before refilling.
If continuous water drainage is impossible, apply Temephos 50% EC @ 1 ml per 1000L or 1g Bti WP.

standard_operating_procedures.title: Overhead Tank (OHT) and Drum Sealing Protocol
steps: Inspect lid tightness. A gap of 2 mm is sufficient for female Aedes to deposit eggs.
Wrap tank overflow pipes with fine nylon wire-mesh (16 mesh per linear inch).
Fasten rubber gaskets on inspection manhole covers.

standard_operating_procedures.title: Construction Sumps & Stagnant Basements
steps: Apply Diflubenzuron 25% WP @ 1 g/1000L or introduce Gambusia affinis biological fish.
Dewater temporary rain accumulations within 48 hours using portable sub-pumps.
Sprinkle mineral larvicidal oil over inaccessible elevator shafts.
